Luis Walter Alvarez (AHL-vah-rehz) was born in San Francisco to physician and medical researcher Walter Alvarez and Harriet Smyth Alvarez. Walter Alvarez was a respected researcher and internist who strongly encouraged young Luis’s interest in mechanics and electronics.

...

Alvarez was a brilliant physicist with unusually diverse research interests for a modern scientist. His contributions as a scientist and a teacher were extensive. The world has yet to achieve Alvarez’s dream of an end to warfare.
